english.title: Vehicle defect - permit the use of a passenger vehicle fitted with tyres with insufficient tread

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a passenger vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), constructed or adapted to carry no more than eight seated passengers in addition to the driver, when the grooves of the tread pattern of a tyre fitted to the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL LOCATION..) wheel of the vehicle were not of a depth of at least 1.6 mm throughout a continuous band comprising the central three-quarters of the breadth of tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27(4) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) For vehicles which require a minimum tread depth of 1mm (i.e. larger goods and passenger vehicles) see offence wordings: H154, H158 and H160.
(ii) This offence wording does not apply to motor cycles
(iii) Use this offence wording for motor cars.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H149 and H150.
(vi See also H422, H423 and H424 in relation to goods vehicles.
(vi) See also H425, H426 and H427 in relation to light trailers.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was a passenger vehicle constructed to carry no more than 8 seated passengers plus the driver on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The grooves in the tread pattern of the tyre fitted to the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL..) wheel of the vehicle were less than 1.6 mm deep throughout a continuous band situated in the central three-quarters of the breadth of tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre.
